subject: Transition brief: WellCurve onboarding timeline & kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Kelsey Turner <kelsey@wellcurvehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Transition brief: WellCurve onboarding timeline & kickoff coordination

Hi team — looping you in to transition WellCurve into CS. Key context below and two small asks so we can lock the kickoff.

Deal background (TL;DR)
- ACV: $420k annual commit (3-tier ded. capacity, US region).
- Use case: Personalized triage/assistant in patient portal + batch embeddings for search relevance.
- Committed go-live: targeted week of 2028-12-11 (customer timeline).

What the customer expects in kickoff
- 60-minute executive kickoff (stakeholders: Kelsey Turner - Head of Product, Jason Lim - Eng lead, and Sarah Park - Security).
- 8-week activation focused on integrations (OAuth + S3 export) and policy/config review.
- Preference for production testing in region us-west-2; they asked about data retention window of 30 days.

Known risks / engineering asks
- They will require a sandbox VPC first — infra team flagged a 5–7 business day window to provision.
- Embedding pipeline expected to process ~1.2M docs initially; recommend quantization guidance from Optimize.
- Security: they requested SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram.

Attachments: WellCurve_MAP_v1.3.pdf (mutual action plan) and WellCurve_SOW_draft_v20281108.docx (SOW draft).

Two asks for CS team before I handoff fully:
1) Can CS lead a kickoff on either Tue 2028-11-14 or Thu 2028-11-16 at 10am PT? Customer prefers Thu if possible.
2) Triage owner for infra provisioning (sandbox + prod region) — who should own vendor requests to infra?

Kelsey — I included Marissa and Tessa from CS; they will lead onboarding once we confirm kickoff. Any constraints I should flag?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Kelsey Turner <kelsey@wellcurvehealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T01:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Transition brief: WellCurve onboarding timeline & kickoff coordination

Thanks Alex — Thu 11/16 at 10am PT works best for us (we have a product review on Tue). Couple of clarifications:
- For the sandbox VPC, we can be flexible on timing but prefer it provisioned by 11/20 so our engs can run integration tests the following week.
- Regarding data retention, 30 days is our baseline but we may ask for a 90-day option for analytics; happy to go with 30 initially.
- Security package: would prefer a single zip with SOC2, architecture diagram, and the data flow spreadsheet.

I’ll send over an attendee list and org chart tomorrow. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Kelsey Turner
Head of Product, WellCurve Health
kelsey@wellcurvehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-10T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Transition brief: WellCurve onboarding timeline & kickoff coordination

Thanks Alex & Kelsey — taking ownership of the onboarding. Quick notes / plan: 

Owner assignments (internal)
- CSM lead / kickoff owner: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com) — will set agenda and run exec kickoff.
- Technical liaison & infra provisioning owner: Ben Carter — will queue infra request and track provisioning ETA with SRE.
- Escalation / commercial contact: Alex Martinez (keeper of the deal / billing questions).

Immediate next steps (before kickoff)
1) Tessa to schedule kickoff for Thu 2028-11-16 10:00am PT and share calendar invite + draft agenda by EOD 2028-11-11.
2) Ben to open infra ticket for sandbox VPC with target provisioning by 2028-11-20. Ben — please include expected ETA and any blockers.
3) Alex to publish the SOC2 + architecture bundle to the Drive link in the thread (Kelsey requested a single zip).

Triage items to monitor
- Embedding scale: need confirmation on initial document count (Alex, can you confirm final number — your MAP says ~1.2M).
- SOW items: I will review the SOW draft and propose a clean copy with explicit acceptance criteria for go-live (will surface redlines by 2028-11-12).

Tessa — you’re the lead here. If anything changes on timing I want a heads-up so we can adjust the provisioning window.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
